name: hireflow
description: HireFlow - AI-Powered Recruitment Platform (Open Source ATS) | 智能招聘 AI 辅助平台

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev -w apps/api
